description: REGRESSION for DATA-SECURITY.md §3.4: identity test user now holds identity-level ego.dsn.read but still has NO dsns_auth record for this DSN. Before the fix, database.Open's AuthDSN check consulted only the per-DSN dsns_auth table and never looked at identity permissions at all, so this would still have been denied. dsns.IdentityAuthorizesAction now lets an identity-wide read grant open the DSN directly.
